title: Dozens of flagship infra projects behind schedule, only 4 on track—DEPDev
summary: Of 37 flagship infrastructure projects targeted for completion by 2028, only 4 are on track to be finished by 2028, according to DEPDev Assistant Secretary Roderick Planta.
